tower-of-hanoi.title: Recursive Hanoi move sequence
tower-of-hanoi.principle: To move a stack of n disks from a source peg to a target peg using an auxiliary peg, first recursively move the top n‑1 disks to the auxiliary, then move the largest disk to the target, and finally move the n‑1 disks from the auxiliary to the target.
tower-of-hanoi.when_to_apply: Whenever you need to relocate a contiguous stack of disks while preserving their order.
tower-of-hanoi.example: Attempting to move a larger disk while smaller disks above it remain on the same peg, causing an illegal move.

tower-of-hanoi.title: Validate each move's legality
tower-of-hanoi.principle: Before committing a move, check that the source peg's top disk matches the intended disk ID, that the disk is actually present on that peg, and that the destination peg is empty or its top disk is larger.
tower-of-hanoi.when_to_apply: For every move you generate, perform these checks.
tower-of-hanoi.example: Moving a disk that is not present on the source peg or moving a disk onto a smaller disk.

tower-of-hanoi.title: Clear blocking disks before moving larger disk
tower-of-hanoi.principle: If the disk you want to move has smaller disks stacked above it, first relocate those smaller disks to other pegs so the target disk becomes the topmost disk on its peg.
tower-of-hanoi.when_to_apply: Whenever a larger disk is not the top disk on its peg.
tower-of-hanoi.example: Moving a disk that has smaller disks on top without first moving those smaller disks away.

tower-of-hanoi.title: Use smallest disk as temporary buffer
tower-of-hanoi.principle: The smallest disk can be placed on any peg without violating size constraints, making it ideal for temporarily freeing pegs needed for larger moves.
tower-of-hanoi.when_to_apply: When you need to clear a peg but have no other suitable disk to move.
tower-of-hanoi.example: Leaving the smallest disk on a peg where it later blocks moving a larger disk onto that peg.

tower-of-hanoi.title: Clear target blocking disk before moving larger disk onto it
tower-of-hanoi.principle: If the destination peg has a smaller disk on top, move that smaller disk elsewhere before moving the larger disk onto the target peg.
tower-of-hanoi.when_to_apply: Before moving a larger disk onto a peg that is not empty.
tower-of-hanoi.example: Moving a larger disk onto a peg where a smaller disk is on top, violating the size rule.

tower-of-hanoi.title: Treat existing larger disks on target as base
tower-of-hanoi.principle: If the target peg already contains some of the final tower’s larger disks in correct order, treat them as a fixed base and only move the remaining disks onto them.
tower-of-hanoi.when_to_apply: When the goal peg already has a partial correct tower.
tower-of-hanoi.example: Attempting to move a disk that is already correctly placed at the bottom of the target peg, causing unnecessary moves.

tower-of-hanoi.title: Clear auxiliary peg of smaller disks before using it for larger moves
tower-of-hanoi.principle: When a peg is needed as the auxiliary (or source) for moving larger disks, ensure that any smaller disks on it are moved elsewhere first.
tower-of-hanoi.when_to_apply: Before using a peg as the temporary holder for a larger disk.
tower-of-hanoi.example: Using a peg that still holds smaller disks as the auxiliary for moving a larger disk, resulting in an illegal placement.

tower-of-hanoi.title: Iterative descending placement
tower-of-hanoi.principle: When assembling the final tower from an arbitrary initial distribution, handle disks from largest to smallest, placing each disk onto its final peg after clearing any obstacles.
tower-of-hanoi.when_to_apply: When constructing the goal configuration step by step.
tower-of-hanoi.example: Placing a smaller disk onto the target peg before the larger disk that should be beneath it, leading to a blocked final arrangement.

tower-of-hanoi.title: Output move list as final parseable list
tower-of-hanoi.principle: After generating the complete sequence of moves, output it as the last list in the response, using the exact format moves = [[disk_id, from_peg, to_peg], ...].
tower-of-hanoi.when_to_apply: At the end of your response, before any trailing text.
tower-of-hanoi.example: Providing the moves inside the reasoning but omitting the final list, resulting in an empty output.

tower-of-hanoi.title: Phase clearing before moving larger disk to final position
tower-of-hanoi.principle: When moving a larger disk to its final peg, first clear any smaller disks from the target peg, then move the larger disk, and finally restore the smaller disks on top.
tower-of-hanoi.when_to_apply: Before placing a disk onto its final location.
tower-of-hanoi.example: Moving a larger disk onto a peg that still has a smaller disk on top, violating the size ordering.

tower-of-hanoi.why_it_happens: The model finishes its reasoning without appending the required moves list, often due to focusing on analysis rather than final output.
tower-of-hanoi.how_to_avoid: Always include the final moves list as the last parseable list in the response, even if the list is empty.

tower-of-hanoi.description: Moving a larger disk onto a smaller disk (size ordering violation)
tower-of-hanoi.why_it_happens: The model selects a move based on convenience without checking the size rule.
tower-of-hanoi.how_to_avoid: Validate that the destination peg is empty or its top disk is larger before moving a disk.

tower-of-hanoi.description: Moving a non‑top disk (attempting to move a disk that is not the topmost on its source peg)
tower-of-hanoi.why_it_happens: The model forgets that only the top disk can be moved.
tower-of-hanoi.how_to_avoid: Check that the disk to move is the topmost on its source peg before generating the move.

tower-of-hanoi.why_it_happens: The model stops generating moves prematurely, possibly due to token limits or early termination.
tower-of-hanoi.how_to_avoid: Ensure the entire sequence of moves is fully listed; verify that the final state matches the goal before finishing.

tower-of-hanoi.description: Moving a disk from a peg where it is not present
tower-of-hanoi.why_it_happens: The model loses track of disk locations during reasoning.
tower-of-hanoi.how_to_avoid: Maintain an explicit representation of the current configuration and update it after each move.
